name: railway_create_custom_domain
description: Add a custom domain to a service (customDomainCreate). Requires `projectId`, `environmentId`, `serviceId` (all from railway_get_project) and `domain` (the hostname to add, e.g. 'app.example.com'). Optional `targetPort` (the container port to route to; omit to use the service default). Returns the new custom domain with status.dnsRecords — the DNS records the user must create at their DNS provider, and status.verificationToken (a TXT record for ownership). After calling this, relay dnsRecords[].requiredValue (the CNAME target) to the user. This attaches a live domain — confirm the exact service and domain first.

domain.description: The custom domain hostname to add, e.g. 'app.example.com'.

targetPort.description: Optional container port to route the domain to. Omit to use the service's default port.

body_defaults.query: mutation customDomainCreate($input: CustomDomainCreateInput!) { customDomainCreate(input: $input) { id domain status { verificationToken certificateStatus dnsRecords { hostlabel fqdn recordType requiredValue currentValue status zone purpose } } } }
